module: Bridge between the drift gameplay and the multiplayer scoreboard (multiplayer_multiplayerScoreboard). When a drift spot starts, creates a scoreboard with the columns potentialScore, driftLevel and score; then pushes the player's score, drift level, status (finishLine / disqualified) and pulses red on a crash. Does nothing if multiplayer_multiplayerScoreboard does not exist.
notes: Score updates are only sent if the drift context is "inFreeroamChallenge".
The drift level (driftLevel) is sent every frame only when the value of gameplay_drift_scoring.getDriftPerformanceFactor() changes.
functionDriftSpotEnded (badly formed local name) sets driftLevel back to 0 and hasDriftSpotStarted to false; scoreboardHandle is never set back to nil.

onDriftScoreChanged.desc: Hook: pushes to the scoreboard the current potential score, score and drift level, in the inFreeroamChallenge context.

data.desc: Score change data (unused here: the score is re-read via gameplay_drift_scoring.getScore()).

onDriftSpotStarted.desc: Hook: when entering a drift spot, creates a new multiplayer scoreboard sorted by descending score.

onDriftSpotFinishLineCrossed.desc: Hook: finish line crossed, pushes the "finishLine" status to the scoreboard.

onDriftSpotFailed.desc: Hook: spot failed, pushes the "disqualified" status to the scoreboard.

onDriftCrash.desc: Hook: crash during a challenge, makes the player's color pulse red in the scoreboard.

getDriftDebugInfo.desc: Returns the table {default=false, canBeChanged=false} describing this module's debug setting (used by the drift debug window).

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: sends the drift level to the scoreboard if it changed since the last frame.
